subject: SLA + Premium Support: regional failover and response tiers
messages:
From: Maria Alvarez <maria@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Eli Chen <eli@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:04:00 -0400
Subject: SLA & Premium Support options for BrightCart

Hi Jordan / Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput gains on the catalog re-ranking look promising. As we prep for our Q4 launch we want to lock down an SLA and premium support package that covers:

- Regional failover (primary in us-east-1, warm standby in us-west-2)
- 99.95% sustained uptime target with defined credit bands
- 30/60/120-minute response tiers depending on severity
- Escalation coverage (on-call + named escalation leads)

Two asks from my side: can you share a short, itemized pricing view for a 12-month commit with the above coverage, and whether you can offer a multi-region discount if we commit to active/standby in both regions? Also, procurement wants an estimate they can use to start an internal PO.

I've attached a short note summarizing our expected traffic profile and peak concurrency (BrightCart_PO_Intent.pdf) — happy to jump on a call to walk through details.

Best,
Maria
Director of Platform Ops
BrightCart

--Attachment: BrightCart_PO_Intent.pdf (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Alvarez <maria@brightcart.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 18:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support options for BrightCart

Thanks Maria — great follow-up. Quick summary below and I attached a one-page options sheet (BrightCart_SLA_Options_v1.pdf). Happy to sync and run a tailored cost model after we confirm concurrency and failover expectations.

High level options (12-month commit):

1) Standard Assurance (base) — $X/month
   - 99.9% uptime, 24x7 ticketing, business-hours response for Sev2
   - Suitable if failover is tolerated for brief windows

2) Assured Regional (recommended) — $Y/month (active primary + warm standby)
   - 99.95% uptime target, automatic warm-standby in second region, health-based failover window (sub-minute to minutes)
   - Escalation: 60-min ack for Sev1, 120-min on-call routing for Sev2
   - Includes quarterly failover DR drills and KB syncs

3) Premium Assured (SRE-on-rotate) — $Z/month (dedicated retainer)
   - 99.99% uptime band, 30-min ack for Sev1, named on-call rotation, monthly runbook reviews
   - Priority engineering pipeline slots and faster rollback/patch coordination

Multi-region discount: we can apply a 10% discount on the Assured Regional and Premium tiers for a dual-region commit (both regions active/standby) at the 12-month volume you indicated. The discount increases to 15% for a 24-month commit.

Procurement estimate: the attached sheet has line items broken into monthly seat/retainer, multi-region capacity surcharge, and optional DR drill credits. If procurement needs a stamped quote/term sheet we can route to Legal — processing usually takes 3–5 business days for a standard agreement.

Action items:
- Maria: confirm target commit length (12 vs 24 months) and expected avg concurrent requests (the PO stub helps)
- Grace/Priyom: can you review the pricing sheet and highlight any ops constraints or additional cost levers (caching/quantization) we should offer as alternatives?

If it helps, I can propose two PRICING rows for the procurement team: one with the 10% multi-region discount applied and one without.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0162

--Attachment: BrightCart_SLA_Options_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>; Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Alvarez <maria@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support options for BrightCart

Looping in some ops-specific notes for clarity — copied to Maria so you have full visibility.

- Warm standby architecture: we recommend configuring automatic KV-cache warmup + prefix caching for catalog traffic to keep failover token costs low. We'll size standby at ~60-70% compute of primary for cost efficiency while still meeting failover RTOs.
- Failover drill cadence: quarterly DR drills included for Assured Regional; premium drills monthly if desired (extra credits).
- Response windows: the 60-min ack for Sev1 assumes SRE incident triage then 30-min mitigation window for critical config/policy rollbacks. If BrightCart needs guaranteed mitigation SLA (not just ack), that moves to Premium.

Also, on pricing levers: we can reduce monthly cost by offering a pre-warmed cache credit package (one-time) and by guiding you to a mixed-precision quantization profile for embeddings-heavy routes. I can prepare a short appendix with estimates if you want.

Priyom Das
Head of Product — Redwood Inference

From: Maria Alvarez <maria@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SLA & Premium Support options for BrightCart

Thanks Jordan and team — this is helpful. BrightCart is prepared to move forward with the Assured Regional tier at the 12-month cadence, pending a final procurement quote and a short clause in the SOW to cover (a) quarterly failover drills and (b) the 10% multi-region discount applied at signing.

A couple of clarifying points from procurement:
- Can you include a line for an optional retainer for named escalation leads (we will consider this if the delta to Premium is reasonable)
- We need the standard liability / data residency notes for EU traffic — while our launch is US-first, we expect some EU traffic later this year.

I'll ask procurement to start a preliminary PO; they may route a formal request to Legal. Please send the procurement-ready pricing rows (with and without the 10% discount) and a one-page SOW addendum we can attach to the PO.

If you want to lock calendar time, we're available Wed 30 Jun 10:00–11:00 ET for a quick procurement walkthrough.

Best,
Maria
Director of Platform Ops
BrightCart
